## Clinical Metrics

The IKDDS haemodialysis audit reports 23 metrics across 7 clinical
domains. This document defines each metric, its target, and the
REDCap field(s) used.

### 1. Demographics

| # | Metric | Function | Fields |
|---|--------|----------|--------|
| 1 | Patient counts | `compute_patient_counts()` | centre_code |
| 2 | Age distribution | `compute_age_distribution()` | age |
| 3 | Gender breakdown | `compute_gender_breakdown()` | gender |

### 2. Primary Renal Diagnosis (PRD)

| # | Metric | Function | Fields |
|---|--------|----------|--------|
| 4 | ERA classification | `compute_prd_proportions()` | dxs01 |

### 3. Dialysis Adequacy

| # | Metric | Target | Function | Fields |
|---|--------|--------|----------|--------|
| 5 | URR median | — | `compute_urr_median()` | qblg9 |
| 6 | URR >65% | >65% | `compute_urr_achievement()` | qblg9 |
| 7 | Session frequency | 3x/wk | `compute_session_frequency()` | hdp01 |
| 8 | Session duration | — | `compute_session_duration()` | hdp02 |

### 4. Blood Pressure

| # | Metric | Target | Function | Fields |
|---|--------|--------|----------|--------|
| 9 | Pre-HD BP | <140/90 | `compute_pre_bp_achievement()` | qblg3, qblg4 |
| 10 | Post-HD BP | <130/80 | `compute_post_bp_achievement()` | qblg6, qblg7 |

### 5. Biochemistry (CKD-MBD)

| # | Metric | Target | Function | Fields |
|---|--------|--------|----------|--------|
| 11 | Phosphate | 1.1-1.7 mmol/L | `compute_phosphate_achievement()` | qblb1 |
| 12 | Adj. Calcium | 2.2-2.5 mmol/L | `compute_calcium_achievement()` | qblb4 |
| 13 | PTH | 16-72 pmol/L | `compute_pth_achievement()` | qblb9 |
| 14 | Simultaneous control | All 3 in range | `compute_ckd_mbd_simultaneous()` | qblb1, qblb4, qblb9 |

### 6. Bicarbonate & Potassium

| # | Metric | Target | Function | Fields |
|---|--------|--------|----------|--------|
| 15 | Potassium | 4-6 mmol/L | `compute_potassium_achievement()` | qbla9 |
| 16 | Bicarbonate | 18-26 mmol/L | `compute_bicarbonate_achievement()` | qbla4 |

### 7. Anaemia

| # | Metric | Target | Function | Fields |
|---|--------|--------|----------|--------|
| 17 | Hb median | — | `compute_hb_median()` | qble1 |
| 18 | Hb 10-12 g/dL | 100-120 g/L | `compute_hb_achievement()` | qble1 |
| 19 | Hb distribution | — | `compute_hb_distribution()` | qble1 |
| 20 | Ferritin >=200 | >=200 ug/L | `compute_ferritin_achievement()` | qblf1 |

### 8. Vascular Access

| # | Metric | Function | Fields |
|---|--------|----------|--------|
| 21-23 | AVF/AVG/Catheter | `compute_access_distribution()` | qhd20 |

## Statistical Methods

### Wilson Score Confidence Intervals

All proportion CIs use the Wilson score method via `wilson_ci()`,
which provides better coverage than the normal approximation for
small samples.

### Spiegelhalter Funnel Plots

Funnel plots use exact binomial control limits (2-sigma = 95%,
3-sigma = 99.7%) via `funnel_limits()`, following the UK Renal
Registry methodology.
